pages.text: Dingding scattered a handful of seeds and planted a little marker stick there.
From a flat stone at the bank's end, Dingding saw the stick line up exactly with the big bamboo.
Mom passed with a basket on her head. "Careful there, Mom—" Crack!
Her foot crushed the stick. She walked on. "What did you say?"
Dingding picked up the broken stick. Where should it go?
Dingding tried this spot, then that.
Everywhere looked the same. The seeds were hidden in the soil.
Dingding climbed back onto the flat stone and looked at the big bamboo.
Dingding found where the stick lined up with it and planted the marker there.
Days later, sprouts appeared only round the stick. Mom tiptoed carefully past.
